import type { Graph } from "@graphrefly/ts/graph";
export function captureStructure(graph: Graph) { return graph.topology(); }
fixtures.explanation: The existing topology API recursively preserves structural nodes, edges, subgraphs and static annotations. It excludes node runtime status/value/version. Pure topology does not prove equal implementation, equal business results or effect permission. Caller metadata is retained and is not security-redacted.
